1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “因为如果你懂政治，你会成为高薪。” Formula: 如果……，就会 + V + Object. Correct: “因为如果你懂政治，你就会找到一份高薪工作。” “高薪” is an adjective and cannot be used after “成为” by itself.
